description: Search German apprenticeship (Ausbildung) listings on ausbildung.de by city + category, or by specific profession nationwide.

apprenticeshipType.description: Filter by the type of vocational training program.
apprenticeshipType.title: Apprenticeship type

category.description: Broad topic/industry to filter the city search. `kaufmaennisch` (commercial/office) is the broadest category and is populated for virtually every city. Not every category has listings in every city — an unlisted combination returns 0 records, not an error. Note: `alle-berufe` (unfiltered) is intentionally excluded because ausbildung.de renders it as an infinite-scroll page with no listings in the initial server response.
category.title: Category (mode=byCity)

citySlug.description: German city name/slug, e.g. `berlin`, `muenchen`, `hamburg`, `koeln`. Umlauts should be transliterated (ä→ae, ö→oe, ü→ue, ß→ss) and spaces become hyphens — the actor also normalizes common input automatically.
citySlug.title: City (mode=byCity)

directApplicationOnly.description: Only keep listings that support direct online application (no email/postal-only listings).
directApplicationOnly.title: Direct application only

expectedGraduation.description: Filter results to listings requiring this school-leaving qualification.
expectedGraduation.title: Required school diploma

includeJobDescription.description: For each listing, also fetch its detail page and add the full description text, contact/address details, and employment type. Slower (1 extra request per record) but much richer output.
includeJobDescription.title: Fetch full job description

keyword.description: Case-insensitive substring match against title, profession title, and company name.
keyword.title: Keyword filter

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records. The actor pages through ausbildung.de's results (~20 listings per page for city searches, ~3 for narrow profession searches) until this cap is reached or the source pool is exhausted (stops automatically after several pages return no new listings).
maxItems.title: Max items

minVacancyCount.description: Drop listings offering fewer open positions than this.
minVacancyCount.title: Min open positions per listing

professionSlug.description: Exact ausbildung.de profession slug, nationwide search (no city filter). Examples: `fachinformatiker`, `kauffrau-im-einzelhandel`, `mechatroniker`, `altenpfleger`, `bankkaufmann`, `koch`, `elektroniker-betriebstechnik`. Browse the full glossary at ausbildung.de/berufe/glossar/ for all ~700 slugs.
professionSlug.title: Profession slug (mode=byProfession)

searchQuery.description: Free-text keyword searched nationwide across profession titles and company names, e.g. `Fachinformatiker`, `Bäcker`, `McDonald's`. Broader than `professionSlug` (exact slug match) — matches partial/fuzzy profession and employer names.
searchQuery.title: Search query (mode=byQuery)

startDateFrom.description: Only keep listings whose training start date (`startsNoEarlierThan`) is on or after this date.
startDateFrom.title: Training starts on or after (YYYY-MM-DD)

startDateTo.description: Only keep listings whose training start date (`startsNoEarlierThan`) is on or before this date.
startDateTo.title: Training starts on or before (YYYY-MM-DD)

topRatedEmployerOnly.description: Only keep listings from employers ausbildung.de has flagged as top-rated.
topRatedEmployerOnly.title: Top-rated employers only

title: Ausbildung.de Vocational Training Scraper Input
